cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says a mobile ID, ID wallet or signed credential is in service.
cells.note: FasoSign, launched on 15 September 2026, authenticates signers and is operational on three government systems (BFA-004, BFA-005), staged across services on the rung as worded, as Cameroon's and Mozambique's e-signature systems are; read as one service, it is stage 3.
